content: कण्व {%a.%} [कण् क्वन्] <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 Talented, intelligent. .²2 Praising; प्र सक्षणो दिव्यः कण्वहोता <ls>Rv. 5. 41. 4</ls>. .²3 Fit to be praised or honoured; <ls>Rv. 10. 115. 5</ls>. .²4 Deaf. .{@-ण्वः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a renowned sage, foster-father of Śakuntalā and progenitor of the line of काण्व Brāhmaṇas. He was the author of several hymns of the Ṛgveda. .²2 (<ab>Ved.</ab>) A peculiar class of evil spirits against whom charms or hymns (<ls>Av. 2. 25</ls>) are used; गर्भादं कण्वं नाशय <ls>Av. 2. 25. 3</ls>. .²3 A praiser. .²4 The founder of Vedic schools. .{@-ण्वम्@} Sin, evil.
